entities.summary: Marcus Wandt is a Swedish test pilot and member of the 2022 European Space Agency Astronaut Group. In January 2024, he became the third Swedish astronaut to visit space, after Christer Fuglesang and Jessica Meir. Wandt is a Swedish and Norwegian citizen, thus becoming the first Norwegian citizen in space.
